assessment_basis: Repository documentation, build entry points and workflow definitions were reviewed. The underlying target tests were not re-run as part of this maturity adoption; this record is not a new CI certification.

evidence.claim: Defines the DAK product purpose, supported x86-64 boot target, project boundaries and current non-goals.
Documents the system architecture, separation of kernel, policy and host-native shell.
States safety, privilege and host-versus-kernel execution boundaries.
Provides the reproducible release-image build and source synchronization entry point.
Defines baseline repository checks, host tests and native build checks.
Repository-owned boot/release implementation is the entry point for the bounded Stage 1 image path.
Contains regression tests for host contracts and the implemented boot-support slice.
The release workflow records BIOS and UEFI QEMU boot verification for the experimental Stage 1 image.

next_gate: Implement and test additional native kernel/runtime primitives beyond the Stage 1 boot slice.
Define and exercise a versioned native boundary between Reaper and the DAK kernel.
Attach exact source, regression-test and target-CI evidence to each promoted gate.
